description: This file implements a C++ wrapper around a hash map, providing functions for iteration, clearing, inserting, removing, and retrieving elements, and exposing a C API for these operations.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_cxx_iter_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element in the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_cxx_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_cxx_clear
methods.description: Clears the hash map, optionally calling a callback on each element.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_cxx_insert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key-value pair in the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_cxx_remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_cxx_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in the hash map.
